newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end higher, rattled by Elf strike.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end higher, rattled by Elf strike.

text.p: NWE oil products were higher on Tuesday with the strike at three Elf refineries continuing to rattle the market.
Naphtha ended higher tracking recent gains in crude and gasoline even as Algeria's Skikda port reopened.
Gasoline ended modestly higher after the strike at three Elf refineries in France entered its seventh day and the arbitrage to the U.S. remained open.
Gas oil rose $1.50 on futures. Premiums were mostly stable but uncertainty over the French strike hit volume.
